h2: Pool Cleaning Jimbaran – Skimming, Vacuuming & Water Balance
intro: If your villa sits between the salt spray of Jimbaran Bay and the dry hills above Bukit Jimbaran, the pool takes a beating from both sides. Pool Cleaning Jimbaran covers everything from a quick pre-guest refresh to pulling a green pool back to clear blue — skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and full water balance in one visit. Send photos on WhatsApp and you'll get a straight quote before anyone shows up.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Hard Water & Hillside Pressure
sections.text: Villas along Jimbaran Bay deal with constant salt-laden air that corrodes fittings, pump seals and ladders within a season. Up in Bukit Jimbaran, the story shifts: hard water leaves calcium scale on tiles, heaters and filter housings, while tank-and-pump setups struggle with low pressure that makes manual cleaning awkward. Either way, the equipment ages faster than it would inland, so a proper clean isn't just cosmetic — it protects the hardware underneath.

sections.h3: Green Pools, Pre-Guest Refreshes & Filter Backwash
sections.text: Most calls here fall into three buckets: a villa in Kedonganan needs the pool spotless before a guest block arrives; water has turned green or cloudy after a dry spell and the filter is clogged; or the waterline tiles are crusted with scale and algae. Each job includes skimming, brushing walls and steps, vacuuming the bottom, backwashing the filter and rebalancing chlorine, pH and alkalinity. If the pump or heater is throwing errors because of low tank pressure up on the hill, I'll flag it while I'm there.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp for a Quote
sections.text: Just open WhatsApp and send three things: a couple of photos showing the pool's current state (surface, waterline, equipment area), your villa's neighbourhood so I can gauge travel time, and whether you need it done before a specific date. The cost depends entirely on what the pool needs; a quick vacuum-and-balance visit is very different from recovering a month-old green pool with a clogged filter. You'll get a clear number back before booking anything.

A few habits save money here. Rinse salt residue off ladders and fittings every couple of weeks if you're near the bay — it eats through chrome fast. In Goa Gong and Kelan, where water hardness hits harder, wipe scale off the waterline tile monthly so it doesn't set permanently. Keep your tank topped up; low pressure makes the pump work twice as hard and shortens its life. And test chlorine and pH at least twice a week in the dry season when evaporation spikes.

faq.q: How long does a one-off pool clean take?
faq.a: A standard visit covers skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and water testing; green-pool recovery may need a second pass depending on how far off the chemistry is.

faq.q: Do you handle the pump or heater if it's failing during the clean?
faq.a: I'll point out what's wrong and explain the fix, but repairs are quoted separately after I see the part. Send photos first so we can talk scope before I arrive.

faq.q: Can I book a clean just before my guests land at Ngurah Rai?
faq.a: Yes — mention your arrival date in the WhatsApp message and I'll slot the visit around it. The pool will be clear and balanced by the time they walk down to the water.
